environment: static check of a CSV file against docs/current/TEST-CATALOGUE.csv; no Worker
limits: Checks that each recorded row is complete and internally consistent; it cannot show that the recorded result is true or that the evidence exists.
A person cannot be verified from a name: the check rejects placeholders, roles and tool or AI names, and a reviewer equal to the executor, nothing more.
The blank register passes by design; a pass of this check says nothing about how much of the catalogue has been executed (see the counts in the report).

checks.label: register file exists and parses: docs/testing/uat/uat-results.csv
header is exactly the register columns, in order
every caseId exists in the catalogue and none is empty
no case appears twice
every case in the UAT scripts has a row
result holds only Pass / Fail / Blocked / Not run or is empty
a row with data in any field has a result
a Pass has executor, executedAt, build, environment, actualResult, evidence, reviewer and reviewedAt
a reviewer is never the executor, and is a named person
a Fail has a defect id (and executor, executedAt, build, environment, actualResult)
a Blocked row has executor, executedAt and the reason
a Not run row carries no executor, evidence, defect or reviewer
dates are ISO dates and a review is not earlier than its execution

self-test: a complete Fail is accepted

self-test: a blank row is accepted

self-test: a duplicate caseId is rejected
